node_roles.audio: Exactly one ordered position in audio_path; transforms PCM in that order.
node_roles.analysis: Read-only tap on one audio node output port; never changes audio or audio delay.

identity: SHA-256 of canonical recipe JSON bytes: sorted keys, compact separators, ASCII, no NaN or Infinity.
invariants: One linear audio path; audio fan-in, mixing, dynamic topology and hot swap are rejected.
Node IDs, provider IDs and port IDs are unique ASCII identifiers; the audio_path matches the declared port chain.
Every provider must be present in the caller's available set; unavailable stages reject before any frame is read.
depends_on edges plus analysis tap edges form a DAG; any cycle rejects the recipe.
An analysis tap must reference exactly one audio output port; missing or ambiguous ports reject.
Integer buffering delay accumulates only over audio nodes; analysis cost never enters audio delay.
Availability is a declared monotonic nanosecond value; source timestamps alone are not availability evidence.
Nonfinite, missing or malformed input, settings and side events reject explicitly; no missing result qualifies a candidate.
An outstanding lease blocks reset and drain; cancellation records abandoned source intervals and forbids epoch revival.
Drain releases remaining accepted source samples within a bounded call cap and then returns EOS.
Fixed v0 is unchanged: 16 kHz mono f32, 160 samples; no ABI, descriptor, registry, provider or default change.
public_v0_abi: unchanged; versioned proposal and model-free deterministic fixture only
